name: Steak Rub

steps.title: Season and rest
steps.body: Generously sprinkle the rub (**1½ Tbsp kosher salt**, **2 tsp brown sugar**, **¼ tsp cornstarch**, **¼ tsp garlic powder**, **¼ tsp garlic salt**, **¼ tsp turmeric**, **½ tsp paprika**, **½ tsp chili powder** and **1 tsp black pepper**) on steak and let rest for about 40 minutes before grilling on hot grill.

yields: About 3 Tbsp, enough for 2–3 lb of steak (estimated)
